sprint.name: Sprint 4: refunds and exchanges reach one final state
sprint.goal: A voided ticket is never refunded or re-delivered again, the bulk refund budget rule is pinned, and an operator can close a provider-failed staff or bulk refund and a settled exchange whose switch was refused (TKT-527, TKT-526, TKT-521, TKT-525, TKT-498).

outcome.headline: S-4 makes voided tickets impossible to refund or re-send at claim time, pins the bulk refund budget rule, and gives operators a recorded end state for provider-failed refunds and refused exchange switches. Ready for the owner close decision; no tag or deployment.
outcome.summary:
All twelve non-closure members are Done on main 00e60199: the five planned stories (TKT-527, TKT-526, TKT-521, TKT-525, TKT-498), the simplification (TKT-579) and six members the owner added during the sprint (TKT-596 dependency updates; TKT-598, TKT-594, TKT-595 after round 1; TKT-602 after round 2; TKT-607 after round 3).

Every receipt at the candidate passed: the gate, the hermetic smoke with production images, the smoke-stack PostgreSQL service tests the owner ruled as the required tier, the focused tests, a host-Chrome browser run, the security workflow and CI. Every High from the four final-review rounds and the member reviews was fixed; none was overridden. Round 4, the last under the cap, returned HUMAN_REVIEW in all four areas.

What the owner should weigh at close: the security council never ran (claude-mythos-5-2 unavailable, no substitute); the outside-transfer path holds no reservation, so the runbook narrows but cannot close the race with an abandonment; ADR-087 accepts that a dispatch admitted before an abandonment can still move money; IMPL2-4 (Stripe duplicate JSON members, TKT-604) is an open Medium and an owner choice at close; DOC4-1 and IMPL4-1 (an impossible example in ADR-087 §14 and the same premise in the CLI refusal text, TKT-608) are deferred. The resend guarantee is at claim time, narrower than the goal's wording.

scope.summary: The original scope was TKT-527, TKT-526, TKT-521, TKT-525, TKT-498, the simplification task TKT-579 and the closure task TKT-580. The owner added six members during the sprint: TKT-596 (dependency updates), TKT-598 (round-1 verification and documentation corrections), TKT-594 and TKT-595 (round-1 IMPL-1 and IMPL-7), TKT-602 (round-2 IMPL2-1, High, security, and DOC2-1..7) and TKT-607 (round-3 documentation corrections). Nothing was removed or carried out. All twelve non-closure members are Done.

implementation.summary: Round 4 initial inspection approved with zero findings: the reviewer traced the refund and resend void checks, the bulk refund limits, the refund-outcome evidence paths, operator configuration and organizer scope, the migrations, TKT-498 decisions D40 and D41, the Back Office redirect guard and TKT-607's runbook statements against the code at 00e60199. The decision audit raised IMPL4-1 (Medium): the record-refund-outcome refusal text still says an unstamped refund can never be proven. It is the same defect as DOC4-1 and is deferred to TKT-608; the runbook takes precedence. The outside-transfer checks narrow the race but do not reserve the refund (risk R-OUTSIDE).

verification.summary: Round 4 initial inspection approved with zero findings: every required receipt at 00e60199 is present and matches the packet, the named smoke-stack PostgreSQL tests meet the owner tier ruling, and the round-3 fixture mutations went red at the intended assertions before six green runs. The decision audit raised VER4-1 (Low): the frozen packet still gave the old TKT-602 mutation count in one place; this report states 53. Live Stripe and mixed-version rollout are not verified.

documentation.summary: Round 4 initial inspection raised DOC4-1 (Medium): ADR-087 §14 gives an unstamped platform leg as an example, which the stamp history rules out; the rule it states stays true. Deferred to TKT-608 with the CLI text, because round 4 is the last round under the cap and a fix would change the reviewed candidate. The decision audit checked this report's draft and approved: its 49 board references match sprint records by digest. The audit could not view the page at narrow width, in dark theme or in print preview.

retrospective.summary: Round 4 initial inspection approved with zero findings in the packet and reconciled the review counts. The decision audit raised RETRO4-1 to RETRO4-3 (Medium) against the report draft: per-member board intervals, the repeated writer-window cause, and the review-independence and routing limits. All three are fixed in this report.

retrospective.summary: S-4 delivered its five planned stories, but each of the first three final-review rounds found a defect class that the member reviews had missed, and the owner added six correction members. Four patterns repeat. First, credentialed outbound calls and provider evidence decoding were checked caller by caller, so the class surfaced late (round 1 IMPL-1, round 2 IMPL2-1 and IMPL2-4). Second, plan narrowing and post-review fixes went forward without a repeat review (TKT-594 D4, TKT-498 D40 and D41). Third, concurrent writers of one row or leg across services opened windows that each review found late (TKT-525, TKT-498). Fourth, operator money procedures stated checks that a reader could take as clearance (TKT-607 P3-1, R1-1, RA2-1). The candidates below are proposals for the owner; none is adopted yet. Board status intervals are not labour time: they include outages, owner waits and idle periods, so active work is n/a where the records cannot separate it. Review limits: gpt-6-luna reviewed TKT-607's plan (rounds 2 to 4) and code and was the round-4 sprint reviewer; gpt-6.2-sol reviewed the first eleven members and sprint rounds 1 to 3. The owner moved routing to codex models during the run (OD2), and the security council never ran.

candidates.observation: The credentialed-call and evidence-decoding class was found late and caller by caller: round 1 IMPL-1 (refundoutcome clients, TKT-594), round 2 IMPL2-1 (Back Office, TKT-602) and IMPL2-4 (Stripe adapter, TKT-604), with open instances TKT-589, TKT-600 and TKT-603.
candidates.proposal: Add to the ticket plan template an inventory of credentialed outbound calls for any change that adds or touches one: producer, credential, redirect policy, evidence decoding and deadline, across all callers of the same transport. Plan review checks the inventory.

evidence.label: Council decision on the round-2 questions

candidates.observation: TKT-607 used all four plan-review rounds and two code-review rounds on one family: checks in an operator money procedure that a reader could take as clearance (P2-2, P3-1 High, P4-1, R1-1 High, RA2-1).
candidates.proposal: In references/quality-practices.md §1 (pre-mortem), require a table for operator money procedures before plan review: each state, the permitted action, the stop condition and the residual risk.

candidates.observation: Plan narrowing and post-review behaviour changes went forward without a repeat review: TKT-594 D4 narrowed the plan after its only plan review (round 2 RETRO2-5); TKT-498 D40 and D41 changed replay behaviour after code review round 4 with materialChange false (RETRO2-6).
candidates.proposal: In the sdlc-ticket skill, require a plan-review round on the final plan when a decision narrows or widens scope after the last round, and classify a fix's observable changes before materialChange is frozen.

candidates.observation: A premise about code history reached a council-approved ticket and a plan before one git command disproved it (TKT-607 P1-1: no pre-stamp refund leg exists). The same premise remains in ADR-087 §14 and the CLI text (DOC4-1, TKT-608).
candidates.proposal: When a plan or runbook states what happened in the past (a commit order, a migration date, a field that did not exist), cite the git command that shows it.

candidates.observation: Model routing failed several times: claude-mythos-5-2 returned "400 unknown provider" three times and no Daybreak model was listed, so the security council never ran; gpt-6.2-astra refused relayed review requests; codex children refused tasks that only pointed at a brief file.
candidates.proposal: Before a sprint starts, check that each configured and council model can start a read-only call, record the result on the sprint, and always put the full brief in the task text.

evidence.label: Council decision on the round-2 questions

candidates.observation: Concurrent writers of one row or leg across services opened windows found late in review: TKT-525 (refund outcome against bulk and staff writers, R1-3, R2-4, R3-1) and TKT-498 (exchange abandonment against binding and replay, D40 and D41); both closeouts list writer windows as a defect class.
candidates.proposal: In the plan template, for a change that adds a writer to a shared row or leg, list each writer, the lock or constraint that serializes them, the gaps across remote calls, and one schedule test per promised result.

approval.note: Exact owner close approval is requested after report publication, byte read-back and matching board pointers.
